scope: Development-only web rental pricing candidate; isolated synthetic tests, local compile and local commit. Not a production price or release certification.

recovery.kind: NEW implementation on current main, not exact restoration of the missing historical temporary web worktree

changes: Validate actual source term, annual mileage and actual advance as well as vehicle/trim/options/colors; do not certify a source by echoed request conditions.
Use existing explicitly bound server rental estimates only within their declared scope; unverified generic nearby/interpolated/unrecorded prices remain rejected.
Apply RENTAL-only policy to new requests without rewriting saved historical LEASE contracts or sent quote amounts.
Preserve web cancellation and one total 20-second timeout across default-trim resolution and quote calculation; no POST after canceled or expired lookup.
Bind selected amount and finance-reference responses to current request generation, retaining source catalogue pagination validation before RENTAL filtering.
Preserve recent vehicle data on PRICE_UNAVAILABLE and PUBLIC_* failures; remove history only for a genuine vehicle-not-found result.
Preserve web guest/referral, document upload and direct-application paths, idempotency and saved quote metadata. Wrap the large-text condition header without changing price calculations.
